title: Alignment lifeline tally and priority notes
body:
Purpose:
This is a light, run-once tracker to help the on-call/product/partnership touchpoints agree where to focus during this week of concurrent rollouts. Not a replacement for the canonical rotas or sprint boards — it is a temporary 'lifeline' view that surfaces: current owner, earliest unblock action, blocking severity, quick ETA, and a tiny priority score so we can align in a 10-minute sync.

How to use (quick):
- Owner adds a single-line entry for any item that needs cross-team alignment. Keep one row per dependency.
- Fill "blocking_action" with the smallest step that will move things forward (can be a DM, access grant, short PR, or test run).
- Triage call (10m daily): sort by priority_score desc, spend max 90s per item for status and commit.
- If no owner after 24 hours escalate to the appropriate manager listed in linked_artifacts.

Columns (free-text, terse):
- id: short id for reference (use existing ticket when possible)
- title: one-line descriptor
- owner: person taking next step
- blocking_action: concrete next smallest unblock step
- blocking_severity: low | medium | high | critical (impact on customers / SLOs)
- est_effort_mins: rough minutes to do the action (helps prioritization)
- eta: expected completion date/time (approx)
- priority_rationale: 1-2 words (customer-impact / launch / infra-risk / legal)
- priority_score: quick heuristic = (severity_weight * impact_factor) / max(1, est_effort_hours) — we keep this as a single number so the triage can sort
- notes: short free-form follow-up / links

Mini-table (current snapshot) — raw rows (copy into a sheet if you want columns):

id | title | owner | blocking_action | blocking_severity | est_effort_mins | eta | priority_rationale | priority_score | notes
---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---:|---
PRJ-1423 | metrics export failing for canary | Mei Tan | add missing env var to staging config (2 lines) | high | 20 | 2026-07-13 15:00 UTC | launch | 8.5 | linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metrics/pull/120
OPS-879 | regional fallback route needs firewall rule | Carlos Reyes | request firewall exception from infra (form) | critical | 45 | 2026-07-12 18:00 UTC | infra-risk | 12.0 | ticket: NET-312
INT-41 | telemetry sampling imbalance | Elliot Brooks | short runbook to re-shard sampling filters (manual run) | medium | 90 | 2026-07-14 12:00 UTC | customer-impact | 3.0 | runbook draft in linked confluence page
LEGAL-ask | contract redline for partner demo | Jordan Alvarez | confirm two clauses with legal (quick DM) | low | 15 | 2026-07-13 10:30 UTC | compliance | 1.2 | LEG-44 on legal queue

Quick prioritization notes:
- Severity weight mapping used for back-of-envelope: critical=4, high=3, medium=2, low=1.
- Impact factor: launch/customer-impact=1.5, infra-risk=1.4, compliance=1.1, other=1.0.
- est_effort_hours = est_effort_mins / 60; priority_score rounded to 1 decimal in the table.

Open questions / unsettled items:
- Do we want the tracker to auto-notify owners on 24h stale? For now we rely on the daily 10m call and the on-call to nudge.
- Should we move high-severity items into a short-term escalation board (Ops-Surge)? If so, which threshold? Proposal: priority_score >= 10 triggers escalation.

Immediate asks for triage (today):
- Mei: land the 2-line env var change and post the final CI link before EOD.
- Carlos: submit the firewall exception form and paste the NET-312 ID in this doc when done.
- Elliot: push the runbook link and tag the sampling job owner in Slack #telemetry.

Quick audit trail (scratch):
- 2026-07-12 09:12 — initial table created (Jordan)
- 2026-07-12 11:45 — Carlos added NET-312 placeholder
- 2026-07-13 08:05 — Mei updated PR link
- 2026-07-14 13:10 — Elliot posted runbook link (verbatim URL copied to notes)

When to delete:
This is ephemeral. If the set of items is resolved or moved to canonical boards (Jira/PRs) we archive a short summary in the Ops weekly notes and delete this file. If the tracker persists longer than two weeks, we should convert it to a proper sheet with automated columns and an owner column enforced.

Notes to self:
- Keep rows terse. Avoid duplicating full ticket descriptions here. Use this as a compass for cross-team short work, not as a backlog.

End of document.
